name: Ikuta Masakazu
source:
The main character. He is a childhood friend of the heroine Nayuka, who was born and raised in the village. 

This spring, he passed the entrance exam to a university after three failed attempts. In the previous work, "Minyo!, Nayuka has been able to eliminate a large number of evil spirits that had been possessing him in the previous work.

He has a body  that attracts evil spirits.

[From [url=http://www.love-juice.jp/takeout/new_miko2.htm]official site[/url]]
